measures.name: GM Hero Card SVG
measures.expression:
VAR _Val   = [Gross Margin %]
VAR _Delta = [Gross Margin % vs Plan]
VAR _Neg   = _Delta < 0
VAR _Sem   = IF ( _Neg, "#A4262C", "#107C10" )
VAR _Tint  = IF ( _Neg, "#FDE7E7", "#E6F5E6" )
VAR _ValLbl   = FORMAT ( _Val, "0.0%" )
VAR _DeltaLbl = FORMAT ( ABS ( _Delta ) * 100, "0.0" ) & " pp vs Plan"
VAR _Arrow =
    IF ( _Neg,
        "<path d='M36 118 l4 5 l4 -5 z' fill='" & _Sem & "'/>",
        "<path d='M36 123 l4 -5 l4 5 z' fill='" & _Sem & "'/>" )
VAR _Months =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        VALUES ( 'dim_date'[CalendarYearMonth] ),
        DATESINPERIOD ( 'dim_date'[Date], MAX ( 'dim_date'[Date] ), -8, MONTH )
    )
VAR _N = COUNTROWS ( _Months )
VAR _Series =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        _Months,
        "@v", [Gross Margin %],
        "@i", RANKX ( _Months, 'dim_date'[CalendarYearMonth],, ASC, DENSE )
    )
VAR _YMin = MINX ( _Series, [@v] )
VAR _YMax = MAXX ( _Series, [@v] )
VAR _YRange = MAX ( _YMax - _YMin, 0.0001 )
VAR _Pts =
    CONCATENATEX (
        _Series,
        ROUND ( 196 + 126 * DIVIDE ( [@i] - 1, MAX ( _N - 1, 1 ) ), 1 ) & ","
          & ROUND ( 92 - 52 * DIVIDE ( [@v] - _YMin, _YRange ), 1 ),
        " ",
        [@i], ASC
    )
VAR _EndV  = MAXX ( FILTER ( _Series, [@i] = _N ), [@v] )
VAR _EndPy = ROUND ( 92 - 52 * DIVIDE ( _EndV - _YMin, _YRange ), 1 )
VAR _EndPx = ROUND ( 196 + 126 * DIVIDE ( _N - 1, MAX ( _N - 1, 1 ) ), 1 )
VAR _SVG =
    "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 340 150'>"
      & "<rect x='0' y='0' width='340' height='150' rx='14' fill='#FFFFFF'/>"
      & "<text x='22' y='34' font-family='Segoe UI' font-size='13' letter-spacing='1.2' font-weight='600' fill='#586472'>GROSS MARGIN %</text>"
      & "<text x='21' y='92' font-family='Segoe UI' font-size='46' fill='#18202A'>" & _ValLbl & "</text>"
      & "<rect x='22' y='106' width='118' height='27' rx='13.5' fill='" & _Tint & "'/>"
      & _Arrow
      & "<text x='48' y='123.5' font-family='Segoe UI' font-size='14' font-weight='600' fill='" & _Sem & "'>" & _DeltaLbl & "</text>"
      & "<polyline points='" & _Pts & "' fill='none' stroke='" & _Sem & "' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>"
      & "<circle cx='" & _EndPx & "' cy='" & _EndPy & "' r='4.2' fill='" & _Sem & "'/>"
      & "</svg>"
RETURN _SVG
